theme.title: Bubble and beyond
theme.subtitle: The 2020 and 2021 Finals
theme.recap: The Lakers won in the 2020 bubble; a year later Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 50 to finish Phoenix.

questions.prompt: How many points did Giannis Antetokounmpo score in the 2021 title clincher?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo scored a playoff career-high 50 points and added 14 rebounds and five blocks

funFacts.text: Giannis reached the championship series after hyperextending his left knee against Atlanta in the East finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Antetokounmpo went down in game four with a hyperextension to his left knee

funFacts.text: Milwaukee rallied from losing the first two Finals games in Phoenix to claim its long-awaited title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks won the next four games

funFacts.text: Jrue Holiday's arrival from New Orleans had bolstered the Bucks' defense before the championship run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks acquired guard Jrue Holiday, a highly respected defensive player

questions.prompt: The 2019–20 Lakers never lost when leading after three quarters. How many such games did they win, playoffs included?
questions.context: Los Angeles Lakers · 2019–20 · regular season plus playoffs

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: to be undefeated in a season when leading entering the fourth quarter, going a combined 57–0 record

funFacts.text: The Lakers–Heat series took place inside the Orlando-area NBA bubble with no paying fans in the building.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: games were played in the Bubble behind closed doors

funFacts.text: Both Finals participants had missed the playoffs the previous year, an unprecedented turnaround for the matchup.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first time that Finals participants had both missed the playoffs in the previous season

funFacts.text: Jeanie Buss became the first female controlling owner to guide her team to an NBA title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jeanie Buss became the first female controlling owner to guide her team to an NBA title

questions.prompt: In his 50-point clincher, how many of his 19 free throws did Giannis make?
questions.note: 17 of 19, a surprise from a weak free-throw shooter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Antetokounmpo made 16 of his 25 shots, and was a surprising 17 for 19 on his free throws

funFacts.text: Giannis's clutch foul shooting contrasted sharply with his struggles at the line earlier in those playoffs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after hitting just 55.6% in the playoffs

funFacts.text: His Finals MVP win made him the youngest recipient since Kawhi Leonard.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the youngest winner at age 26 since Kawhi Leonard (22) in 2014

funFacts.text: The Bucks secured the championship behind lockdown defense from Jrue Holiday on Devin Booker.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: His defense helped limit Booker to 19 points

questions.prompt: In Game 1 of the 2021 Finals, Phoenix made how many free throws in a row before its first miss?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Phoenix made their first 25 free throws and nearly set a record for most free throws in a game without a miss

funFacts.text: Chris Paul scored heavily in his Finals debut and dominated the third quarter for Phoenix.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In his finals debut, Chris Paul scored a game-high 32 points

funFacts.text: Giannis returned from his knee injury and made an emphatic chase-down block on Mikal Bridges.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: made a chase-down block of a layup attempt by Mikal Bridges

funFacts.text: A late miss by Jae Crowder ended Phoenix's pursuit of a perfect night at the foul line.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: until Jae Crowder missed with 24.8 seconds left in the game

questions.prompt: Chris Paul reached his first Finals in 2021. How many NBA seasons had he played by then?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: At 36 years old, Paul made his first Finals appearance after 16 seasons in the league and 10 All-NBA selections.

funFacts.text: Paul arrived in Phoenix via an offseason trade from Oklahoma City, part of the Suns' rapid turnaround.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Suns' Chris Paul, acquired from the Oklahoma City Thunder in the offseason

funFacts.text: The Bucks and Suns were both expansion franchises that began playing in the same year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Phoenix and Milwaukee each began play as expansion teams in 1968

funFacts.text: Paul became the first player ever to lose four NBA playoff series after holding a two-games-to-none lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Paul became the first player in NBA playoff history to lose four series in which his team led 2–0
